newsitem.title: USA: Dresser sees loss on sale of some assets.
newsitem.headline: Dresser sees loss on sale of some assets.

text.p: Dresser Industries Inc said Friday it will have a loss on the sale of certain assets by its Sub Sea International for $102 million in cash.
Dresser said the sale to Global Industries Ltd will be booked in the third quarter, adding the loss which will not be material to the company's results of operations.
The principal assets included in the sale are construction barges, liftboats and dive support vessels based in the United States, Middle East and Far East.

Dresser said that all of Sub Sea's Gulf of Mexico activities related to Remotely Operated Vehicles and engineering as well as its substantial activities in Europe and Brazil are excluded from the sale.
It said Sub Sea plans to expand these activities in pursuit of additional deepwater oil and gas production work.
